summary: This sermon teaches that witnessing is not about bringing God to people through perfect words or arguments, but about bringing ourselves to God's work already in progress. The Holy Spirit does the convicting and convincing; our role is to rely on Him, stay attuned through prayer and Scripture, and courageously obey His promptings in conversations with those around us.
key_points: Witness is joining God's work already happening, not carrying the burden of results
The Holy Spirit convicts, convinces, and tells us what to say
Jesus did everything by the Spirit's power, not His own
Our role: rely on the Spirit, embrace simplicity, be courageous
Living in the Spirit through prayer and Scripture tunes us in to His voice
big_idea: Effective witness flows from partnering with the Holy Spirit who is already at work in people's lives, not from our own persuasive words or efforts.
title: PTW Witness: PARTNER WITH THE HOLY SPIRIT
